description: HTML sample page demonstrating creation and destruction of CKEditor instances via JavaScript functions 'createEditor' and 'removeEditor', including embedded scripts and minimal styling.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Creates a CKEditor instance inside the 'editor' div, initializing it with empty or existing HTML content.

methods.name: removeEditor
methods.description: Retrieves data from the CKEditor instance, displays it in the 'editorcontents' div, and destroys the editor instance.
